descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows a podocyte, with its processes contacting three glomerular capillaries. A primary process of the podocyte branches to form secondary processes called pedicels, which rest on the glomerular basal lamina. Pedicels from one podocyte alternate with those from a different podocyte as they contact the capillary. Also visible is the fenestrated capillary endothelium. 6000x

marcadores.explicacao_original: The thick basal lamina is formed by fusion of the individual podocyte and endothelial cell basal laminae. This layer plays a critical role in the glomerular filtration process as fluid leaves the capillary lumen and enters Bowman’s space.
